csv_project_name: Bloomington S Walnut St Corridor Study & Design
csv_scope_of_work: The City is seeking a consultant to develop a Corridor Study and Conceptual Design for the for the 2.4 mile S Walnut Street corridor from Allen Street to Rhorer Road (the Study). The Study will reflect the vision, goals, policies, and programs of the City s Comprehensive Plan, Transportation Plan, and Safe Streets and Roads for All Safety Action Plan and help the City advance towards its goal of eliminating fatal and serious injury crashes on the City s roadways by 2039.

title: Bloomington South Walnut Street Corridor Study and Design
short_description: Consulting services for a 2.4-mile urban corridor study and conceptual street design.
project_scope: Corridor study and conceptual design for the 2.4-mile South Walnut Street corridor from Allen Street to Rhorer Road in Bloomington. The study is intended to align with the City's Comprehensive Plan, Transportation Plan, and Safe Streets and Roads for All Safety Action Plan, with the goal of improving roadway safety and reducing fatal and serious injury crashes.
services: Corridor study, conceptual design, civil engineering, traffic design engineering, transportation planning, land use planning, planning/master planning, urban studies/planning/design, and related electrical engineering support.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a corridor study and conceptual street design assignment, not a bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Strong focus on transportation planning, urban planning, and safety policy implementation rather than structural engineering.
- No identifiable bridge, long-span structure, or architecturally demanding load-bearing structure.
- Falls close to pure urban/open space planning and planning studies, which are not a target area for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Only consultant contract value is indicated at USD 200,000-400,000 for study and design services; no realistic construction cost estimate can be derived from the provided information alone.
fee_explanation: No explicit sbp fee or design fee is stated. The source only indicates an overall consultant contract value range of USD 200,000-400,000.
references_qualifications: Requested disciplines include civil engineering, housing and urban development, land use planning, planning/master planning, electrical engineering, traffic design engineering, transportation planning, and urban studies/planning/design. No specific minimum reference projects or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided source.
